name: Scroll Velocity
description: Rows of large marquee text that drift horizontally and speed up or reverse with page scroll velocity. Alternate rows run in opposite directions, with optional drag, skew, outline and edge fade.
contents: One horizontally scrolling row per entry in texts
Each row repeats the text numCopies times with optional separator
behavior: Rows drift at a constant base speed and accelerate with scroll speed, flipping direction when scrolling up
Odd-indexed rows move in the opposite direction
Content loops seamlessly by wrapping at one copy width
Optional pause on hover, drag with fling inertia, skew and vertical scale surge on velocity, outlined alternate rows, faded left and right edges
Motion stops when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Row texts and number of rows, separator, gap, copies count
Base speed, scroll response and spring feel
Font size, weight, color, extra classes and inline styles
Pause on hover, drag, skew and scale reaction, outlined alternate rows, edge fade

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the default font family, size or tracking
needsCodeEdit.where: className string on the motion.div in VelocityText

needsCodeEdit.change: Make all rows move the same direction
Change edge fade width or curve

fixed: Default parallaxClassName and scrollerClassName are 'parallax' and 'scroller', which need no matching CSS
Tracks window scroll unless scrollContainerRef is given
Default text is bold sans, 4xl on mobile and 5rem from md, with a drop shadow
Pause on hover applies to the whole section, not a single row
Draggable rows allow only vertical touch panning and suppress clicks after dragging more than 6px
Renders nothing when texts is empty
